description: Codex in Arkestra rooms through your own Codex CLI, by ChatGPT login or API key.
auth.auto: The stored API key if there is one, otherwise the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login (subscription).
auth.subscription: Always the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login (subscription).
auth.apiKey: Always the stored API key. It is kept apart from your own Codex login.
model: Model for Codex's turns. Empty: the CLI's default.
sandbox: What Codex's commands may touch during turns in a room.
sandbox.workspaceWrite: Read anything, write inside the workspace.
